🎨 Welcome to +1 Slime Keyboard Paint! 🟢

Paint colorful keyboard keys with your slime and complete exciting stages!

🎨Paint all the keys to complete each stage!
🏆 Earn Wins by completing keyboards!
🌈 Increase your Paint Range as you earn more Wins!
🚀 Unlock new stages and keep progressing!
⭐ See how far you can go!

Have fun painting keyboards!
